turns.text:
One of the 9 text layers on the Order screen failed WCAG AA. I fixed it with the file's own `Muted` colour, and all 9 now pass.

**The failure:** the footnote "Delivered to the door · no signature" (13 px) was `#B9B6AE` on the `#F6F4EE` background. That's a contrast ratio of **1.84:1**, and it needs 4.5:1. The colour was typed in directly rather than taken from the file's colour variables, and it doesn't match any of them.

**The fix:** I linked the footnote's colour to the `Muted` variable (`#6B6F76` in Light mode). That's the colour already used by "Placed 2 Oct · 3 items" on the same background, so it now measures **4.58:1** and passes. Because it's linked to the variable rather than typed in, Dark mode picks up `Muted`'s dark value (`#9DA3AB`) too. I didn't run the check on a Dark-mode view.

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Footnote colour | `#B9B6AE` (typed in, not a file colour) | `Muted` → `#6B6F76` |
| Contrast | 1.84:1 ❌ | 4.58:1 ✅ |
| Screen total | 8/9 pass | 9/9 pass |

**Before:** the footnote is faint and hard to read.
![before](showcase/sessions/contrast-claude-code-1.png)

**After:** the footnote is the same grey as the "Placed…" line.
![after](showcase/sessions/contrast-claude-code-2.png)

Nothing else changed.

**Things to know:**
- **Close to the limit:** "Placed 2 Oct" and the footnote both sit at 4.58:1, just over the 4.5 minimum. If the background colour ever darkens a little, both will fail.
- **Saved copy:** the fix is in `checkout-contrast-fixed.fig`, and the original `checkout.fig` is unchanged. The saved copy was read back and matches, but it hasn't been opened in Figma yet. Opening it there is the last check.
